label: preparing
what: Likely coordinated provisioning for a gathering in or near the great hall, possibly a surprise associated with the day 1 18:00 lighting inspection. Baker supplied bread that freight, innkeeper and builder repeatedly deposited in the same chest; builder also supplied baker with lanterns and planks. The mayor was informed of the lighting inspection, so that part was not secret. The record does not establish that the provisioning or any gathering was concealed from him, nor a specific celebration. Secretary and neighbour cannot be identified as knowing helpers on this evidence.
